newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Nov PPI 1.6 pct, quickens to 1.7 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Nov PPI 1.6 pct, quickens to 1.7 pct y/y.

text.p: issued the following economic indicator details.
CROATIA PRODUCER PRICES NOVEMBER JAN-NOV OCTOBER NOV '95

NOTES -- November prices of production materials rose 2.8 percent and of consumer goods 0.3 percent from October, while capital goods were flat. Producer prices were 1.2 percent higher in November than at the end of 1995.
Croatia introduced a radical anti-inflation programme in October 1993, when monthly producer price inflation was running at 29.1 percent.
